_doc: EIGHTH HELD-OUT real project (Phase 4 final measurement): nanopb (samples/realworld/nanopb, ~5K lines of C; Protocol Buffers for embedded systems: the core library plus two example applications, as a firmware project embeds it; the generated *.pb.h files are not present: uncompiled). Questions written from facts verified in the source AFTER all Phase 4 fixes and BEFORE Verity was ever run on it. First runs kept in bench/results/realworld_heldout8/first-run-*.

cases.q: What happens when the output buffer is full while encoding?
What happens when the decoder needs more bytes than are left in the input?
What happens when a decoded message is missing a required field?
What happens when a varint is too long?
What happens when a field arrives with the wrong wire type?
What happens when messages are nested too deeply?
What happens when an array has more items than its maximum size during encoding?
What happens when the decoder reads a tag of zero?
